_note: Lite edition of the RAINMOJO SO AI platform and crawler registry. Public facts only: platforms, answer surfaces, retrieval, crawler tokens with vendor, role and evidence tier, robots policies, declared-preference standards and sources. Every weight, point value, status band and numeric inspection target of the full registry has been removed; each platform carries a checklist whose items are answered PASS, FAIL or COULD NOT VERIFY.

evidence_tiers.official: Vendor publishes the token, its purpose and usually an IP list or reverse DNS pattern.
evidence_tiers.observed: Token appears in community robots lists or server logs; vendor publishes no documentation or verification.
evidence_tiers.none: Vendor publishes no crawler identity; fetches are indistinguishable from browsers. Crawler access cannot be scored.

unverifiable_policy: When crawler_evidence is not official (Grok, DeepSeek, Qwen), crawler access is reported as COULD NOT VERIFY, never guessed and never counted as a fail.

inspection_ids.passage.definitional_block: first paragraph after H1 is a short passage phrased as a definition
inspection_ids.freshness.days_since_modified: days since dateModified, article:modified_time or Last-Modified
inspection_ids.facts.numeric_density: numbers, percentages and prices per passage
inspection_ids.headings.hierarchy_clean: exactly one H1 and no skipped heading levels
inspection_ids.headings.question_count: H2 to H4 phrased as questions
inspection_ids.render.ssr_text_ratio: visible text to HTML ratio high enough that the text is readable without JavaScript
inspection_ids.faq.present: FAQPage JSON-LD, or several question headings
inspection_ids.social.x_profile_linked: sameAs or link to x.com or twitter.com
inspection_ids.schema.author_byline: author in JSON-LD, rel=author, or byline element
inspection_ids.index.indexable: no noindex in meta robots or X-Robots-Tag
inspection_ids.index.snippet_controls_open: no nosnippet and no max-snippet below 160
inspection_ids.entity.wikidata: evidence: wikidata_present (aiso-brand-mentions); a sameAs link alone is COULD NOT VERIFY, not presence
inspection_ids.entity.youtube: evidence: youtube_channel_active; a link alone is COULD NOT VERIFY, not presence
inspection_ids.agent.operable_controls: no clickable div or span and no unlabeled inputs (AI-Ready Web hand-off)
inspection_ids.social.x_sentiment: evidence: x_brand_sentiment in {positive, neutral, mixed, negative} (aiso-brand-mentions sampling of recent X posts)
inspection_ids.entity.tech_hub_presence: evidence: tech_hub_presence (GitHub organisation, developer docs, Stack Overflow or Hugging Face presence recorded by aiso-brand-mentions)
inspection_ids.content.promo_density: promotional superlatives per passage (best, number one, guaranteed, Thai equivalents); lower is better

friendly.description: Allow every documented search and user-fetch crawler; leave training crawlers allowed.

selective.description: Allow search and user-fetch crawlers (visibility), disallow training-only crawlers.

blocked.description: Disallow every AI crawler, keep classic search engines.

declared_preferences._note: Machine-readable usage preferences a site may declare in 2026. None of the ten platforms states compliance with them, so the audit parses and reports them (transparency) and never scores a platform on them. A site that declares ai-input=no or search=no has opted out of AI answers by policy; the report says so instead of recommending fixes.

content_signal.where: robots.txt line: Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no
content_signal.origin: Cloudflare Content Signals Policy, 2025-09-24, auto-applied to 3.8M+ managed robots.txt files

content_usage.where: HTTP header Content-Usage or robots.txt line Content-Usage:
content_usage.origin: IETF AIPREF drafts (aipref-attach-05, aipref-vocab-07, 2026-08), Standards Track, not yet an RFC

rsl_license.origin: Really Simple Licensing 1.0 (Reddit, Yahoo, Quora, Cloudflare, Fastly, Akamai and publishers)

crawler_paywall.origin: Cloudflare Pay Per Crawl under AI Crawl Control (private beta, 2026)
crawler_paywall.audit_rule: classify 402 on a crawler user agent as crawler paywall, not as a server error

cloudflare_ai_bot_policies.note: Cloudflare presets (Search, Agent, Training) with new-zone defaults from 2026-09-15 allowing Search and blocking Training and Agent on ad-bearing pages; a site on Cloudflare may block a documented search crawler at the edge without a robots.txt line, so robots.txt ALLOWED is necessary, not sufficient

agentic_browsers_note: Agentic browsers carry no crawler token: ChatGPT Atlas and the ChatGPT Work cloud browser, Perplexity Comet, Claude in Chrome, Gemini in Chrome, Edge Copilot Mode, Grok Bot, Meta Muse. They appear as ordinary browser traffic and robots.txt cannot address them; the audit reports agent readiness (operable controls, labels, live regions) instead of crawler access for them.
